chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Amr ibn Saeed, from Musaddaq ibn Sadaqa, from Ammar ibn Musa, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about the woman who dies in her post-childbirth bleeding (nifas), how is she washed? He said: Similar to the washing of the clean (free from major impurity), and similarly the menstruating woman, and similarly the one in major ritual impurity (junub). Indeed, she is washed with one washing only.

key_terms.الطَّاهِرَةِ: The clean one (free from major impurity)
key_terms.الْجُنُبُ: The one in major ritual impurity

ai.seo_question: How is a woman washed if she dies during post-childbirth bleeding?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the ritual washing (ghusl) for a woman who dies during post-childbirth bleeding (nifas) is identical to that of a free woman, requiring only a single bath rather than multiple washings for each state of impurity. This ruling aligns with the general principle in Shia jurisprudence that major impurity (junub) and minor impurities (hayd/nifas) are consolidated into one comprehensive ghusl for the deceased, streamlining the funeral rites. The hadith underscores the consistency of ritual purity laws regardless of whether the impurity is currently active or ceased at the time of death.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Amro Bin Saeed, from Musaddaq Bin Sadaqa, from Ammar Bin Musa, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the woman when she dies in her post-childbirth bleeding, how would she be washed. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Similar to the washing for the cleanliness (menstruation free), and similar to that is the menstruating woman, and similar to that is the one with sexual impurity. But rather, she would be washed with one washing only’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ahmad ibn al-Hassan ibn Ali from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from ‘Ammar ibn Musa who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a woman who dies during her child- birth, how Ghusl (bath) to be given for her? He (the Imam) said, ‘It is just like cleansing Ghusl (bath) after blood discharge is over and so also is the case with a woman during her Hayd (menses) and after sexual relation: only one Ghusl (bath) is sufficient.’”
